cards.title: How to reload a prepaid number
cards.content: To reload (recharge) a HUTCH prepaid number online, open the HUTCH Reload/Pay Bill portal at reloadpay.hutch.lk (or the Reload option on hutch.lk), enter the HUTCH number, choose the amount and, if you want, a data pack, then choose a payment method and enter your card details. You can also reload in the Hutch Self-Care app. Online reloads accept local Visa, Mastercard or Amex debit and credit cards; international cards can use ding.com or etopuponline.com. A prepaid online reload can be from LKR 50 to LKR 50,000, and HUTCH adds no extra charge. After a successful reload you receive an SMS with the credited amount and an email receipt.

cards.title: Hutch Self-Care app
cards.content: The Hutch Self-Care app lets you reload, check your balance and usage (data, voice and SMS, up to the last 30 days), activate voice, SMS and data plans, see offers, manage up to 10 HUTCH numbers, and register a complaint. It is available on Google Play, the Apple App Store and Huawei AppGallery. HUTCH does not charge data for using the app.

cards.title: How to check your balance and usage
cards.content: You can check your balance and your data, voice and SMS usage for up to the last 30 days in the Hutch Self-Care app. HUTCH customer support also offers a Check Balance option on its website.

cards.title: How to activate a package or data plan
cards.content: You can activate HUTCH voice, SMS and data plans in the Hutch Self-Care app. When you reload online at reloadpay.hutch.lk you can also choose an optional data pack together with the reload amount. Available plans and their prices are shown in the app and on hutch.lk.

cards.title: Contact HUTCH customer support
cards.content: You can contact HUTCH customer support on the 1788 hotline (24 hours, 7 days), by WhatsApp chat on 0788 777 111 (chat only), or by email at cs@hutchison.lk. The HUTCH website also has a service point locator.

cards.title: How to register a complaint
cards.content: In the Hutch Self-Care app you can register a complaint from Menu, then Support, then Register Complaint. You can also contact HUTCH customer support on the 1788 hotline or by WhatsApp chat on 0788 777 111.

cards.title: If a reload did not reach your balance
cards.content: After an online reload the payment site shows whether it succeeded or failed, and a successful reload is confirmed by an SMS with the credited amount. A taken payment and a credited balance are different things, so do not pay again while a reload is pending; contact HUTCH customer support on 1788 or by WhatsApp on 0788 777 111 with your payment details.
